start: Challenges, gym online, no challenge running

steps.action: Open Challenges
user_sees: Page "Challenges" with "A challenge for your members. Everyone who reaches the goal wins."
A card "No challenge is running"
The button "New challenge"
must_not: An endless "Loading…"
A challenge of another branch shown as this one

steps.action: Tap "New challenge"; type the Name, pick "Workouts" under "What counts", type the goal, the "First day", "How many days" and "Free days for everyone who reaches the goal"
user_sees: Hints "Members see this name. At most 60 letters.", "Today or a later day, up to 60 days from today.", "From 7 to 31 days.", "From 0 to 60. You check each winner before the days are added."
A preview of what members will read, in place of "Fill in the boxes above to see what members will read."
must_not: A preview that names other days or another goal than the boxes

steps.action: Tap "Start challenge"
user_sees: The button reads "Saving…", then the toast "Challenge saved. Members see it in the MettleUp app within 10 minutes."
The challenge in the list as "Running now" or "Not started"
must_not: Two challenges after a double tap
The toast shown when the save failed
A last day that is one day off from first day plus the number of days

start: Challenges, the ready-made challenges list (another kind of challenge)

steps.action: Tap the turn-on button of a ready-made challenge
user_sees: A sheet with the ready-made name as its title and the boxes already filled
must_not: Empty boxes
A first day in the past

steps.action: Save it
user_sees: A toast that it is on, and the ready-made row now offers to change it or turn it off
must_not: A second running challenge on the same days

start: Challenges, the "Leaderboard · last 30 days" section (another kind: the standing board)

steps.action: Pick "Rank by" workouts or kg
user_sees: The top members with their totals, or "Nobody to show yet. Totals appear after members train and open the MettleUp app."
"<n> of your members trained in the last 30 days."
must_not: A member who chose not to show their name listed by name

steps.action: Hide one member from the board
user_sees: Toast "<name> is hidden from the leaderboard." and the name under "Hidden from members" with "Show again"
must_not: The member still shown to other members
The member totals deleted

steps.action: Tap "Show again"
user_sees: Toast "<name> is on the leaderboard again."
must_not: The member staying hidden after a reload

steps.action: Leave the Name empty and tap "Start challenge"
user_sees: "Give the challenge a name, like “November challenge”."
must_not: A save with no name

steps.action: Type a name, a goal of 0, then 5 in "How many days"
user_sees: "Type the goal as a number above 0.", then "It must run from 7 to 31 days."
must_not: A challenge saved with a goal nobody can count or reach

steps.action: Pick "Visits", type a goal of 20 and 10 days
user_sees: "The visits goal cannot be more than the number of days the challenge runs."
must_not: A visits challenge that no member can win

steps.action: Pick days that another challenge already uses and save
user_sees: "Another challenge already uses some of these days. Pick days that are free, or cancel the other challenge first."
must_not: Two challenges on the same day
The typed boxes cleared after the refusal

start: Challenges on a gym that is not online yet

steps.action: Open Challenges
user_sees: "Challenges need your gym online" with "Members’ phones read the challenge from your gym’s server. Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data)."
must_not: A "New challenge" button that saves nowhere
A raw error code

start: Challenges, one challenge not started and one running

steps.action: Tap "Change" on the challenge that has not started, edit the goal, tap "Save changes"
user_sees: The sheet "Change the challenge", then the new goal on the card
must_not: A second challenge made in place of the change

steps.action: Tap "Cancel challenge" on the running one
user_sees: "Cancel this challenge?" with "“<title>” will disappear from members’ phones. Nobody gets free days for it. This cannot be undone, but you can start a new one."
Buttons "Keep it" and "Cancel challenge"
must_not: A cancel with no question first

steps.action: Tap "Cancel challenge"
user_sees: Toast "Challenge cancelled. Members no longer see it."
The challenge under "Past challenges" as "Cancelled"
must_not: Free days given for a cancelled challenge
The challenge still on member phones after 10 minutes

start: Challenges, a finished challenge with 3 winners waiting for the owner

steps.action: Open the finished challenge under "Past challenges"
user_sees: "3 reached the goal, 3 waiting for the owner"
Each winner with "Won 7 free days. Waiting for the owner." and the buttons "Give 7 free days" and "Skip"
The note about checking a surprising number with the member before giving free days
must_not: Free days already added before the owner tapped Give

steps.action: Tap "Give 7 free days" on one winner
user_sees: "Saving…", then the toast "7 free days added for <name>. Plan now ends <day>."
must_not: The days added twice after a double tap
A plan end date that did not move by 7 days

steps.action: Tap "Skip" on the second and "Give all 1 their free days" for the rest
user_sees: "Skipped. <name> gets no free days." and the line "Skipped"
A winner with no running plan shows "Give by hand: 7 free days. No active membership."
must_not: A skipped winner getting days later
A winner who left the gym getting days

start: Challenges, a finished challenge with winners

steps.action: Tap "Copy this list"
user_sees: Toast "List copied. You can paste it into WhatsApp."
The copied text holds the title, the days, the goal and each winner with name, phone number and result
must_not: Winners of another gym or branch in the text
The list sent anywhere by itself

steps.action: Open Challenges on a front desk (staff) login
user_sees: "Only the owner can start, change or cancel a challenge. You can see who has reached the goal."
No Give, Skip, Change or Cancel buttons
must_not: Staff able to add free days to a plan from here
